<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex026012026-11-0601-44-07" status="reviewed"><seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex026012026-11-0612-20-04" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3816">byang yes</rs> na re rten 'brel bsgoms pas zhes nas | de gzung pa med par rtogs la | 'dzin pa med par ma rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan du sbyar ba la | de phyir rang <expan>bzhin med</expan> par rtogs pa'i rgyur bshad pa la bye brag rgyu mtshan du 'gro lugs mi shes gsung yang | de ni gzung pa stong pa'i rten 'brel tsam bsgoMs pa'i phyir zhes gsung ngo</seg>
				<lb edRef="inst:4652" n="101b3"/> °°°°° pa spyod mi nges kyis kyi tshul skan thos kyi de nyid yin pas ches 'bras bu'i dbang du byas ste gzung yang de mi rigs te tshogs ma spyod pa'i gnyis pa'i mthong laM gyi khyed par sgra myed du 'gyuro || </seg></TEI>
